title: Out of context error
description: This chat is reaching the AI’s memory limit, like a whiteboard filling up. We can expand the memory window (called context size) so it remembers more, but it may use more of your computer’s memory. We can also truncate the input, which means it will forget some of the chat history to make room for new messages.
increaseContextSizeDescription: Do you want to increase the context size?
lastRequestOverflowed: Last request overflowed the context window.
contextOverflowDetail: This request needed {{request}} tokens, but the model’s context window holds only {{context}}.
contextOverflowGeneric: The request exceeds the available context size.

engine.unknown: The model engine reported an unexpected error.
engine.BINARY_NOT_FOUND: The engine program is missing. Reinstalling the engine from Settings should restore it.
engine.MODEL_FILE_NOT_FOUND: The model file could not be found. It may have been moved or deleted.
engine.LIBRARY_PATH_INVALID: The engine's library folder is invalid. Reinstalling the engine from Settings should restore it.
engine.MODEL_LOAD_FAILED: The model could not be loaded.
engine.DRAFT_MODEL_LOAD_FAILED: The draft model could not be loaded. Turning off speculative decoding will let the main model run.
engine.MULTIMODAL_PROJECTOR_LOAD_FAILED: The vision component of this model could not be loaded, so images will not work.
engine.MODEL_ARCH_NOT_SUPPORTED: This model's architecture is not supported by the current engine. Updating the engine from Settings may add support.
engine.MODEL_LOAD_TIMED_OUT: The model took too long to load and was stopped. A smaller model or a smaller context size usually helps.
engine.MISSING_SHARED_LIBRARY: A library the engine needs is missing, so it cannot start.
engine.GPU_DRIVER_TOO_OLD: Your GPU driver is too old for this engine. Updating the driver, or switching to the CPU engine in Settings, will fix this.
engine.OUT_OF_MEMORY: There is not enough memory to run this model. A smaller model or a smaller context size usually helps.
engine.INVALID_ARGUMENT: One of the model's settings is not valid.
engine.DEVICE_LIST_PARSE_FAILED: Jan could not read the list of available devices from the engine.
engine.IO_ERROR: A file could not be read or written while starting the model.
engine.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong inside Jan while starting the model.
